name: Hisui Aito
source:
[i]"I-I-I will do my utmost to support all of you!"[/i]

Hisui was a normal employee at a general company, but he is now an Analyst of Information Processing in the Special Organization Ord, affiliated with the First Class of the Special Investigation Department. He is skilled in video analysis and is able to collect, analyze and recover information from Street AI. He is also the basic engineer of the Special Investigation Department. Since Walter was assigned to the Special Investigation Department, Hisui started to support Walter's physical condition by monitoring Walter. He is a shy person and is always acting nervous.

[From [url=https://velvet-react.com/en/chara004.php]Official Website[/url]]
